blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — An 11-year-old boy was killed while a man was wounded after they were hit by stray bullets during an armed encounter between two rival groups of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) in Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur, early Wednesday, a police official said. Major Joel Lebrilla, Shariff Aguak police chief, identified the fatality as alias “Mohamidin” and the wounded man as “Aswad.” Montaser Saliao, head of the Shariff Aguak Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO), said 329 families were displaced by the fighting and ensuing tensions.
